name: Thank You Gratitude Human Review Queue
critical_warning: This queue is for human review only. Approval here does not publish records, create routes, create Stripe links, or expose candidates in buyer flow.
approval_law: Human review may approve internal readiness only. A separate approved_public promotion step is required before any buyer-facing use.
